properties.description:
`cargo test -p reflow2-core --test a_repair_can_say_what_it_invalidated` — 10 cases.

The suite existed from PR #321 and was simply never visible to the design; this Verification is the record catching up, not new coverage.

WHAT IT PINS, and all three of the capability's restraints are in here — these are the ones a later "simplification" would reach for first:
  • `invalidating_a_check_never_moves_its_status` — the claim says the last RESULT is stale, never that the check now passes. The edge is not RESOLVES and must never become it.
  • `a_finding_with_no_claim_is_not_reported` — nothing is inferred. A finding nobody claimed against is reported as having none, which is a real answer rather than a silence.
  • `an_undated_claim_says_nobody_can_tell_rather_than_no` — `rerun_owed` is THREE-valued; null means one side is undated. Collapsing it to false would turn "nobody can say" into "nothing is owed", which is the reassuring answer and the wrong one.

Also covered: the claim is read back with whether a re-run is owed; a run postdating the repair owes nothing; the edge never enlarges a blast radius; recording a repair does not suppress unrelated gaps; a hand-written change can carry its date; and the same edge closes a stale temporal fact.
properties.findings:
`cargo test -p reflow2-core --test a_repair_can_say_what_it_invalidated` — **10 passed, 0 failed**, 0.05s. Run unpiped, exit code captured on its own line and read from the background task's OWN output rather than from a log read mid-run (both traps this repo has been burned by).

RUN BEFORE THE VERIFICATION WAS MARKED, not after. The suite was known to exist and known to have shipped green in PR #321, and neither of those is evidence about today — a check recorded as passing on the strength of its history is the forgery this field exists to prevent.

All ten green: a_hand_written_change_can_carry_its_date, a_finding_with_no_claim_is_not_reported, a_repair_can_name_the_check_it_answered, a_run_that_postdates_the_repair_owes_nothing, an_undated_claim_says_nobody_can_tell_rather_than_no, invalidating_a_check_never_moves_its_status, invalidates_never_enlarges_a_blast_radius, the_claim_is_read_back_with_whether_a_rerun_is_owed, recording_a_repair_does_not_suppress_unrelated_gaps, the_same_edge_closes_a_stale_temporal_fact.
properties.name: A repair's claim is read back, and it never moves what it invalidated
